bio: 100 Queen's Gate Hotel - London is a prestigious location in Kensington and boasts this luxury hotel by Hilton's Curio Collection, where the mouth-watering Afternoon Tea is as pleasing as the surroundings.  A recent multi-million pound refurbishment has seen the hotel transformed into a haven of elegance and sophistication, featuring a swanky cocktail bar and the restaurant Botanica, located in an airy atrium, where Afternoon Tea is served.  In Botanica, you are invited to indulge in the quintessentially British tradition of Afternoon Tea. Their Afternoon Tea is accompanied by a carefully selected blend of teas from Newby, paired perfectly with pastries and savouries created by the team of in-house chefs who will take you on a unique experience.  This central location is just a stones-throw from local attractions so why not have a stroll around Hyde Park or visit the V&A and Natural History museums?
